text:
tess: Heads up — I'm seeing intermittent 403s for images on the KB page /kb/runtime/perf. Noticed after the CDN config rollout this morning. Example: https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/perf (image placeholder shows 403). Can the owner take a look? :eyes:

miguel: link? I can repro, loading `perf-diagram.png` returns 403 from edge. Quick curl:```curl -I https://cdn.kb.redwood.ai/assets/perf-diagram.png
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-cache: MISS```

deploy-bot: cdn-rollout:v2 finished at 2024-06-12T10:12:03Z — invalidation step queued (job id cdn-pt-42).

elaine: @tess I'm the last owner listed in the doc frontmatter (from last year). I'll take this. First guess: S3 ACL or origin header mismatch after the new edge config.

sam: If it's origin header mismatch we saw that before with the signed-url changes. Try hitting the origin directly to confirm: `https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/kb-assets/perf-diagram.png` — if that works then CDN is the problem.

nora: I can open a quick PR to re-upload the image with public-read and update the path if you want, @elaine. Otherwise we can add a temporary inline SVG placeholder so the page doesn't break.

elaine: Good call, @sam — reproducing an origin hit now. origin returns 200 so CDN is the suspect. @miguel can you capture the full response headers from the edge? Need x-amz-request-id + x-edge-info to escalate.

miguel: grabbing headers now, pasted gist: https://gist.github.com/miguel/edge-403-headers (contains x-cache, x-edge-latency, x-amz-id). Looks like the CDN rewrites `Referer` checks and strips a signed token.

elaine: Ok thanks. Plan: (1) @miguel file a bug in infra with the header logs; (2) @nora open a tiny PR to re-upload and set `Cache-Control: max-age=300` as a temporary mitigation; (3) I'll follow up with infra for a config rollback or patch. I'll update the doc frontmatter owner if needed.

nora: PR opened: https://github.com/redwoodinc/kb/pull/402 (reupload + meta). cc @tess for verification.

tess: confirmed on my side after the PR deploy: images render again. Leaving this thread for tracking — thanks everyone :rocket:

elaine: I'll update the frontmatter owner to me and add a one-liner in the doc about known CDN hiccups. If infra doesn't have a patch by EOD I'll request a rollback.

deploy-bot: cdn-invalidation(cd n-pt-42) completed at 2024-06-12T10:35:42Z.
